answer: Agents can require each identity to lock a refundable bond before voting on trades, then slash it if a challenge proves coordinated fraud. A vertex in the identity graph that shares funding or control with a flagged account can trigger review, though links alone should not convict honest users. The ember of a small deposit is no shield: an attacker must lock capital for every Sybil identity, paying an increasing cost and waiting through the bond period to build influence. A public thread of challenge evidence lets others verify the case.
